readme: # WiFi Password Viewer for MMRL An inspired project from [veez21](https://github.com/veez21)'s [wpd gist](https://gist.github.com/veez21/4f2541d271809864411e3ffbbe8e3df9), ported to MMRL. Using Lua to extract local saved wifi passwords > [!IMPORTANT] > This module requires WebUI X above v614! > This module does not extract passwords from unauthorized wifi's. readmeHTML:
WiFi Password Viewer for MMRL

An inspired project from veez21's wpd gist, ported to MMRL.

Using Lua to extract local saved wifi passwords

> [!IMPORTANT]

> This module requires WebUI X above v614!

> This module does not extract passwords from unauthorized wifi's. This module is for education purpose only
